data.source: Hugging Face Datasets, the published splits
data.note: the validation split is carved out of the training data; the published test split is scored once per model and chooses nothing

contamination.note: normalising lowercases, strips punctuation and collapses whitespace, so it catches reformatting that an exact match misses

logistic_regression.timing_note: model forward only, on an already vectorised matrix. Predicting 7,600 rows from a sparse matrix takes a few milliseconds in total, close enough to the timer floor that repeated measurement spans a threefold range. The spread is recorded rather than hidden behind a median

linear_svm.timing_note: model forward only, on an already vectorised matrix. Predicting 7,600 rows from a sparse matrix takes a few milliseconds in total, close enough to the timer floor that repeated measurement spans a threefold range. The spread is recorded rather than hidden behind a median

configuration.head: sequence classification, 4 labels, randomly initialised
configuration.scheduler: LinearLR, factor 1.0 to 0.0 over all steps
configuration.padding: dynamic, to the longest item in each batch

comparison.note: the comparison the README leads with is DistilBERT against the strongest classical baseline, which validation selected before any test score was looked at
